connectivity_convention: B is covalently bonded to two phenyl ipso carbons and to quinolinolate N and O; the ligand is deprotonated at O. Aromatic ring numbering follows standard 8-hydroxyquinoline numbering (N=1, C2 adjacent to N, O at C8); substituents are at the stated positions.

environment.default: isolated monomer with implicit toluene solvent

aggregate.definition: two BQ7 molecules in a stacked arrangement; use only if a reproducible dimer starting geometry is generated and fully documented
